module pulse_detect #(
    parameter s0 = 2'b00,
    parameter s1 = 2'b01,
    parameter s2 = 2'b10,
    parameter s3 = 2'b11
) (
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input data_in,
    output reg data_out
);


reg [1:0] state;

always @(*) begin
    case(state)
        s0: begin
            if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                data_out = 1'b0;
            end else begin
                data_out = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        s1: begin
            if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                data_out = 1'b0;
            end else begin
                data_out = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        s2: begin
            if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                data_out = 1'b1;
            end else begin
                data_out = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        s3: begin
            if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                data_out = 1'b0;
            end else begin
                data_out = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        default: begin
            data_out = 1'b0;
        end
    endcase
end

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if(!rst_n) begin
        state <= s0;
    end else begin
        case(state)
            s0: begin
                if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                    state <= s1;
                end else begin
                    state <= s0;
                end
            end
            s1: begin
                if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                    state <= s1;
                end else begin
                    state <= s2;
                end
            end
            s2: begin
                if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                    state <= s3;
                end else begin
                    state <= s0;
                end
            end
            s3: begin
                if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                    state <= s1;
                end else begin
                    state <= s2;
                end
            end
            default: begin
                state <= s0;
            end
        endcase
    end
end
endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Pulse Detection Module</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="INITIAL">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WAIT_FOR_ONE">Waiting for '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ONE_DETECTED">'1' detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WAIT_FOR_ZERO">Waiting for '0'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ZERO_DETECTED">'0' detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="PULSE_END">End of pulse.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" width_description="[3:0]">State register.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[3:0]">Next state register.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            case(state)
                INITIAL: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = WAIT_FOR_ZERO;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                    end
                end
                WAIT_FOR_ONE: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = ONE_DETECTED;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                    end
                end
                ONE_DETECTED: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = WAIT_FOR_ONE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = PULSE_END;
                    end
                end
                WAIT_FOR_ZERO: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = ZERO_DETECTED;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = WAIT_FOR_ONE;
                    end
                end
                ZERO_DETECTED: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = PULSE_END;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                    end
                end
                PULSE_END: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = WAIT_FOR_ZERO;
                    end
                end
                default: next_state = INITIAL;
            endcase
        </always_comb>
        
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(~rst_n) begin
                state <= INITIAL;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
            end
        end
        
        assign data_out = (state == PULSE_END);
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Sequential logic for detecting pulses based on input signal transitions.</implementation>
</module>
